changePolicy: Later matrix changes require a schemaVersion bump or documented change record before they can affect Ready Catalog acceptance.
principles: Ready Catalog entries are production-grade across web and Flutter from day one.
No stub or placeholder implementations are allowed for Ready entries.
Flutter is first-class and must render every Ready entry fully.
Block categories are capability metadata, not replacements for ADR-003 source taxonomy.
Data integration uses general-purpose DataSource adapters, not BitCode-specific bindings.
Mutation integration uses a future ActionSource/ActionAdapter contract.
Required reactivity in Ready entries uses Portable Expression AST, not string expressions as the foundation.
Duplicate analysis is based on contract equivalence, not label similarity.

statusLegend.existing-component: Existing web and Flutter components cover the concept; usually needs only a catalog entry or schema preset.
statusLegend.existing-component-needs-binding: Existing components cover the UI, but the block needs DataSource/ActionAdapter wiring or catalog presets.
statusLegend.schema-preset-only: No new component should be created; compose existing primitives/components via schema preset.
statusLegend.component-gap: A new Bc* component is required in packages/ui and packages/ui-flutter before this can be Ready.
statusLegend.contract-gap: A component exists, but its contract is insufficient for the target block semantics.
statusLegend.adapter-gap: UI exists or can be composed, but a general-purpose DataSource/ActionAdapter/capability adapter is missing.
statusLegend.duplicate-alias: Reference name is an alias of a canonical entry and must not become a separate Ready entry.
statusLegend.excluded: Raw reference is intentionally excluded from v1 core Ready Catalog, with reason.

requiredNewFoundationalWork.description: Add BlockCatalogEntry, Ready/Candidate catalog types, category/channel/capability enums, readiness metadata, examples, adaptive policy, security/i18n/offline/versioning/test gates to @bitcode/ui-schema.
Add ActionSource, ActionAdapter, ActionResult, ActionError, ActionEffect, ActionRunner lifecycle, and Web Component/Flutter event parity.
Add Portable Expression AST plus built-in function registry manifest. Ready Catalog cannot depend on string expressions for required behavior.
Add BcBlockRenderer as a thin layer over BcRenderer with schema/component strategies and platform component registries.
Add build-time and runtime validators for Ready Catalog: no stubs, web + Flutter component availability, schema/action/expression/security/i18n/adaptive/test gates.
